message.content: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","agent_id":"researcher","description":"Research 'Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) lithium‑ion home battery systems'. Produce a structured markdown summarizing: technology overview, chemistry and cell type, typical system architectures (AC vs DC‑coupled), round‑trip efficiency, usable capacity and depth of discharge, cycle life and calendar life, safety considerations, typical costs (installed $/kWh and standalone battery $/kWh), common vendors/models for home use, typical sizing guidance for a 3–6 kW PV household, warranty practices, environmental impacts and recyclability, pros/cons, and a list of primary sources with links and dates. Include any quantitative tables or metrics and note uncertainties or data ranges.","dependencies":[],"produces":"lfp_battery_research.md","consumes":[],"rationale":"Alice can use web search and RAG skills to gather and cite current market and technical data for one technology.","needs_tools":["web_search"]},{"id":"s2","agent_id":"researcher","description":"Research 'Vanadium redox flow (VRFB) or other flow battery systems for residential/home energy storage'. Produce a structured markdown summarizing: technology overview, chemistry and cell type, system architectures, round‑trip efficiency, usable capacity and depth of discharge, cycle life and calendar life, safety considerations, typical costs (installed $/kWh and standalone $/kWh), common vendors/models for home use (or small commercial scaled for homes), sizing guidance for a 3–6 kW PV household, warranty and maintenance practices, environmental impacts and recyclability, pros/cons, and a list of primary sources with links and dates. Include quantitative tables or metrics and note uncertainties or data ranges.","dependencies":[],"produces":"vanadium_flow_battery_research.md","consumes":[],"rationale":"Alice should research the competing flow‑battery technology in parallel to the LFP research.","needs_tools":["web_search"]},{"id":"s3","agent_id":"orchestrator","kind":"meeting","attendees":["researcher","data_analyst","creative"],"description":"Chair a team meeting to review the two research artifacts (lfp_battery_research.md, vanadium_flow_battery_research.md). At the table, review_artifacts from the researchers, discuss key similarities/differences, reconcile any conflicting data or numbers, decide which metrics and tables must appear in the final comparison, and record_decision capturing the agreed structure, recommended audience, and any outstanding data gaps to resolve.","dependencies":["s1","s2"],"produces":"team_discussion.md","consumes":["lfp_battery_research.md","vanadium_flow_battery_research.md"],"rationale":"A chaired meeting brings researcher, analyst and writer together to align interpretation and the report outline.","needs_tools":[]},{"id":"s4","agent_id":"creative","description":"Write the comparison report as a single Markdown file named comparison_report.md. Use the two research artifacts (lfp_battery_research.md, vanadium_flow_battery_research.md) and the meeting record (team_discussion.md). Produce: executive summary (recommendation and best use cases), a clear side‑by‑side comparison table of key metrics, detailed sections summarizing each technology, discussion of tradeoffs (cost, lifespan, efficiency, safety, installation), recommended decision criteria for homeowners, open questions/uncertainties, and a consolidated reference list of sources with links. Include embedded tables and highlight any numbers flagged in the meeting as uncertain.","dependencies":["s3"],"produces":"comparison_report.md","consumes":["team_discussion.md","lfp_battery_research.md","vanadium_flow_battery_research.md"],"rationale":"Eve is best suited to synthesize, format and produce the final Markdown report for the user.","needs_tools":["read_file","write_file"]}]}
